snapshot.title: Customer Complaint: Chlorine Smell, Off-Taste

fields.subject: Customer reports water smells like chlorine, tastes off — 2701 Hilltop Blvd
fields.description: Customer (2701 Hilltop Blvd): Water smells like chlorine, but not strong. Tastes off. Called 03:30 AM. No service issues at my end. Should I boil it?

activity.author: Customer Service Lead
activity.text: Ticket received from Customer Service log. Verified on the outage map: Zone 2 has no active advisories. AIT-611 shows residual at 0.45 mg/L (normal: 0.5–1.2). No feed or setpoint change logged. Notifying PIO for rumor log entry.

activity.text: Ticket created. Status: New. Priority: Low. Assigned to: Customer Service / Water Quality Liaison.
